text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — NimbusCorp go-live on Wed is still a go but they hit a couple of warmup hiccups this morning, want to confirm quota windows and autoscale knobs.
kevin_sre: Saw their logs, 504s during prefix-warmup at ~120rps, looks like batch size bump caused headroom exhaustion.
amrita_sales: Customer is nervous — renewal conversation next quarter, want to avoid them seeing instability. Can we prioritize stability over max throughput for first 48h? :pray: 
jonah_eng: Agreed. Recommend temporary autoscale policy: min_replicas=4, max_replicas=12, target_util=65%. Also enable KV prefix cache for top-10 endpoints.
maria_cs: Can someone paste the load profile we'll run for the smoke tests? I'll share with Nimbus eng lead Olivia.
kevin_sre: Load profile attached below.
kevin_sre: ```
# loadgen config
rps: 150  # steady
p95_payload: 40 tokens
spike: +60rps for 3m at t+30m
duration: 20m
concurrency: 50
``` 
kevin_sre: Run command: `./run_load.py --cfg nimbus_warmup.yaml --region us-west-2 --auth token` :gear:
olivia_nimbus: Thanks — we're on standby for the spike window, will monitor tail latencies and refresh caches before spike.
amrita_sales: Also want a short enablement call with their SREs tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk the runbook and fallback triggers.
maria_cs: Scheduled. Jonah, can you own the runbook walkthrough? You'll cover fallback to smaller model and traffic split to fallback pool.
jonah_eng: Yep. I'll prepare a 15-min slide + playbook. Fallback commands:
jonah_eng: ```
# fallback traffic shift
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/routing/shift -d '{"percent":30, "pool":"fallback"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
``` 
kevin_sre: Also point-of-contact during the run: @kevin_sre on-call, and ops-bot will post autoscale anomalies. I'll add a panic checklist to the runbook.
maria_cs: Olivia, any concerns from your side before we run the smoke at 1400 PT?
olivia_nimbus: Only ask is to ensure KMS keys are validated for logging — compliance team flagged that yesterday. I'll confirm in 30m.
amrita_sales: Noted — flagging as potential renewal risk if not cleared. We'll pause billing-sensitive ops until KMS check passes.
maria_cs: Cool. After the smoke, please paste a short postmortem thread here: top 3 findings, any config rollbacks, and customer sentiment (happy/concerned).
olivia_nimbus: Will do. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Scheduled smoke test at 3311223600, reminder posted 10m before. :robot_face:
maria_cs: Thanks team — aim is to keep Nimbus confident. I'll compile notes for AE and CSM.
